notes: server=http://127.0.0.1:8080; logprobs requirement evaluated separately (rate above). llama.cpp b12121 CUDA 13.4 on driver 591.86, Qwen3VL-8B Q4_K_M + mmproj F16 read from NVMe, flags -c 8192 -ngl 99 --parallel 2, requests sequential, temperature 0.
